title: 2007 Mercedes CLK 200K Sport Cabriolet for sale by auction
content:
2007 Mercedes CLK 200K Sport Cabriolet
- Mileage
- 39,513 mi
- Prev owners
- 2
- Engine
- 1.8L
- Horsepower
- 181 BHP
- Fuel
- Petrol
- Gearbox
- Auto
Description
Highlights
- Well-presented and very usable convertible
- Just two former keepers
- Supercharged German performance
- Low-mileage example
- Black Nappa leather
Overview
The Mercedes CLK 200 Sport is part of the elegant second-generation CLK range, offering a refined convertible with sleek styling and everyday usability. Being the sport model, you are treated to AMG styling, larger alloy wheels, and sports suspension.
Powering the CLK is the 1.8-litre Kompressor (which, translated, means it’s supercharged), which delivers decent economy when compared to the larger six-cylinder versions. The performance is more than capable of putting a smile on your face, especially when the sun's out and the roof is down.
Inside, Mercedes didn’t disappoint, using high-quality materials typically found in mid-2000s models. The Nappa leather adds a nice touch of luxury, complemented by the Avantgarde aluminium trim, which adds a modern, sporty feel.
A fantastic convertible with just under 40,000 miles, cared for by just two former keepers, has helped keep the Mercedes CLK in great condition for the past 18 years.
History and Documentation
- V5C present and in the vendor's name
- Registered 4th December 2007
- Two former keepers
- Owner’s manual
- Two keys present
- Extensive history file
- Services carried out at the following intervals: 20th November 2008 @ 6,870 miles, 20th November 2009 @ 10,879 miles, 28th September 2010 @ 13,414 miles, 26th October 2011 @ 16,530 miles, 20th November 2015 @ 24,128 miles, 15th November 2016 @ 25,189 miles, 20th November 2017 @ 26,528 miles, 18th November 2019 @ 29,256 miles, 26th August 2025 @ 38,608 miles
- The current MOT is valid until 1st October 2026 and was passed with no advisories
- HPI clear
Interior
- Avantgarde trim package
- Black Nappa leather seats
- The seats are in excellent condition with no signs of excessive wear
- Electric front seats
- Both door cards are in good order with no damage
- Isofix system
- Black dashboard with aluminium trim package
- Air conditioning
- Cruise control
- Multifunction steering wheel with paddle shifters
- Automatic dimming mirror
- The seller advises that the electric mirrors have been disconnected as they do not fold out reliably
- All instruments are working correctly with no warning lights displayed
- The odometer shows 39,513 miles
- The switchgear is in good condition and is said to be working correctly
- Unfortunately, the radio screen has delaminated on the right-hand side, and the centre air vent controls have become sticky, which is common on a CLK
- CD multi-changer
- The carpets are in good, clean condition
- A set of fitted mats are in place, and there is a set of genuine AMG mats included
- Inside, the boot is clean and tidy
- The first-aid kit, warning triangle, and locking wheel nut are present
Exterior
- Finished in Telurium Silver Metallic
- Pillarless body which makes for an elegant silhouette
- The paintwork is in excellent condition for the age of the vehicle, with just a few minor age-related stone chips
- The electric door mirrors are currently not working, but it has not been investigated as to why
- Headlight wash system
- The headlights are in good condition with no damage to the lenses
- Looking around the car, the panel gaps appear to align as they should
- No dings or dents were spotted
- The windows are in good order with no noticeable scratches
- AMG styling package, which consists of the front spoiler and side skirts
- The blue fabric roof is in good condition and operates correctly
- Rear light lenses are free from damage
- AMG-Spoken 18-inch alloy wheels
- Three of the wheels have some very minor kerb rash, but could be easily refurbished
- The tyres have a good amount of tread remaining
Mechanical
- 1.8-litre four-cylinder supercharged
- Produces approximately 184bhp and 184lb-ft of torque
- 0–60mph in approximately 9 seconds
- Five-speed automatic transmission with paddle shift
- Rear-wheel drive
- Recent service carried out less than 1,000 miles ago
- Volumetric Air Regulator replaced in July 2025
- The car fires up without hesitation and runs with no issues reported by the vendor
- Over 8,000 miles have been enjoyed by the vendor, including a trip to Italy in the summer
- Factory sports suspension
- No knocks or bangs are said to be coming from either corner of the car
- The Mercedes comes to a stop in a straight line, with no juddering through the pedal
Summary
This 2007 Mercedes CLK 200 Sport is impressive inside and out. Finished in the lovely Telurium Silver, the CLK benefits from AMG styling, AMG wheels, and an electric roof. Inside is decked out in black Nappa leather and Avantgarde aluminium trim, bringing a modern look to the sporty cab.
With a service carried out less than 1,000 miles ago, the Mercedes is ready to be enjoyed, which is precisely what the current vendor and his wife did in the summer with a thoroughly enjoyable trip over to Europe.
Where will you be taking this low-mileage Mercedes CLK next? The world is your oyster, enjoy it!
To arrange a viewing, click the ‘Book Viewing’ button located under the ‘Place Bid’ button. Viewings can be booked up until the day before the auction ends, after which the option will change to ‘Contact Seller’ for further enquiries. This seller is located in Coventry.
